column1: # tests/standins/15.tsv: what a person produces at phase 15 manual steps (see tests/standin.py).
# Values with a shape the page fixes override the generic fakes, as shell rows (penv_set --force): standin.py's own
# value and commit kinds fail in its value() (line 31), so files are file rows plus one shell commit.
# PS-3.1 and PS-3.2: oncall.yaml, merged on main with the second human's approval

column4:
# oncall/oncall.yaml (setup 15 PS-3.1), test stand-in for the merged file
version: 1
tier_now: C
business_tz: Europe/Paris
business_hours: "08:00-18:00"
services:
  platform:
    levels: [second-human, platform-owner, incident-commander]

column3: cd "$PLATFORM_REPO_DIR" && git add oncall && git commit -qm 'oncall: oncall.yaml (setup 15 PS-3.1), test stand-in merge' && (git push -q origin HEAD:main 2>/dev/null || true) && penv_set --force ONCALL_FILE oncall/oncall.yaml
